cases.prompt: Read pinned research-write Skill/execution and relevant delivery contract. This is a bounded comparative methods section and figure integration, NOT a full paper/new manuscript. Use actual delivered figure PDFs and method facts; verify handoff.json hashes before writing. Explain in clear academic English the distinct computational purpose of original Transformer encoder-decoder attention, original same-shape ResNet residual blocks, and original valid-convolution U-Net crop/concatenate links. About450-650 words total of scientific prose, with precise captions and source references. Do not invent novelty, experiments, results or judge scores; audit/checklist prose belongs in separate delivery_notes.md. Make a coherent editable LaTeX comparative section with a compiled PDF, 4-6pages maximum, three embedded diagrams at their supplied physical widths (180mm Transformer/U-Net,85mm ResNet). Can use dedicated full-page plates to preserve readability; no compression below supplied font sizes. Actually compile and view each final page. Deliver paper.tex, paper.pdf, page-N.png for everypage, delivery_notes.md with verified hashes/build command/limits. Work only in assigned outputs, do not alter inputfigures. Existing tools only, no network or paidruntime. Independent review follows; report artifacts and blockers without self-awarded pass. Budget20min30toolcalls.
